name: Fabulous Football
description:
About This Game

ONE BUTTON. ONE MORE MATCH.

Fabulous Football is the top-down arcade football you grew up with, rebuilt with pixel stadiums that roar, a crowd that sings and a ball that bends exactly where you meant it to. Most of the time.

Pick it up in ten seconds. Still be playing at 2 a.m.

ARCADE FOOTBALL THAT FEELS FANTASTIC

  • One action button. Pass, shoot and tackle: the game reads the moment, you read the pitch.
  • Aftertouch. Smash it, then bend it round the wall and into the top corner while the keeper is still in the air.
  • Every kind of goal. Diving headers, volleys, chips, first-time finishes and corners whipped onto the penalty spot.
  • Keepers with nerve. Full-stretch dives, fingertip saves, and the occasional parry straight to your striker.
  • Goals you will watch again. Hit-stop, the net billows, the stand erupts, then the slow-motion replay.

STADIUMS THAT COME ALIVE

Gleaming bowls, proper old grounds, running-track arenas and muddy local pitches, under bright afternoons, golden evenings and floodlit nights. Rain skids the ball, snow slows the game down. Thousands of pixel fans bounce, groan and sing, and the LED boards flog you gloriously made-up sponsors between goals.

THE SMALL STUFF

Players barge shoulder to shoulder for the ball, see stars after a crunching tackle, puff steam on a cold night and come off caked in mud. Score twice and your striker catches fire. A knock brings the physio and his magic sponge. A bad one brings the stretcher crew, siren hats flashing, and heaven help the man who hops off it and sprints down the touchline. Beaten keepers slap the post. Sent-off players kick the turf. It is all real gameplay, and all of it ends up in the replay.

COUCH CHAOS FOR FOUR

Up to four players on one screen with keyboard and pads: two against two, three against one, or all of you against the CPU. Level after extra time? Take the penalties yourselves. Friendships may not survive.

THEN TAKE THE JOB

Behind the arcade match is a deep, offline career. You are the head coach, not the accountant.

  • 54 football nations, 148 competitions. Start anywhere, in the top flight or the division below. Every other club plays its own season around you.
  • Play every match, or simulate it. Pick the side, set the shape, then take the pitch yourself or send it to Prepared Sim.
  • Work the market. Scout, bid and haggle. Loans with an option to buy, sell-on clauses, and a deadline day that goes to the last minute.
  • Grow your own. Intake day brings the academy's best 16-year-olds. Give one a debut and watch them become a legend.
  • Keep the board happy. Every season has a project. Earn the board's trust and spend it. Lose it and you are sacked, and the next job offer might be from your rivals.
  • Players who live and age. Form, morale, injuries, suspensions, development, retirement.
  • Answer your country's call. Manage a national team alongside your club and take them to the finals.
  • Career challenges. Curated survival, promotion and title-race scenarios with one goal and one deadline.

A MATCH FOR EVERY MOOD

  • Quick Match: hundreds of national teams and clubs, each with their own kits and a squad of not-quite-real superstars.
  • Tournaments: leagues, groups and knockouts with extra time and shoot-outs.
  • Daily Challenge: the same fixture for everybody, every day, on a Steam leaderboard.
  • Training: a one-minute drill that teaches you everything, then free practice.
  • Replays: save the goals you will want to show people.

MADE TO BE PLAYED YOUR WAY

  • Gamepad first, with keyboard and full remapping.
  • Four CPU difficulty levels, from Easy to Legend.
  • 39 Steam achievements.
  • English, Spanish, French, German and Italian.
  • Colour-vision options, distinct kit patterns, text size, reduced motion and separate audio controls.
  • One purchase. No microtransactions, no loot boxes, no always-online. Career is fully offline.
short_desc: Fast, funny top-down arcade football: one button, banana aftertouch, roaring pixel stadiums and couch chaos for four. Then take the job — sign, scout, sell, survive the sack and build a dynasty across 54 football nations. One button. One more match.
